jobs.scope: retained normalized scanner observations -> real classification -> real saved risk assessment; HTTP ingest and durable queue scheduling are outside this check
jobs.denominator: unique original scanner vulnerability identifiers (CVE or advisory ID) per service; database uniqueness is service_id + cve

definitions.authoritative_vex: Exact CVE/PURL candidate; trust, freshness and product context may still reject it.
definitions.applicable_vex: At least one trusted current statement with exact identity and required product context. Conflicts remain unresolved.
definitions.no_intelligence: No current applicable VEX, current advisory reference, affirmative KEV or available EPSS.
definitions.identity_rejected: An exact candidate failed identity requirements, or an explicitly labelled different-product sample proves CVE presence. Date/revision rejections alone do not count.
definitions.denominator: Distinct active finding IDs, unioned across observations and sources. Image denominators use distinct finding IDs in that image; image totals overlap.

jobs.global_application_engine: disposable in-memory SQLite; actual work explicitly bound to populated PostgreSQL
